description: This file defines an Android foreground service named NodeForegroundService that manages and displays the connection status of an OpenClaw node. It handles notification creation, lifecycle management, and integration with the runtime status through Kotlin coroutines.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: An Android service that runs in the foreground to monitor and display the status of an OpenClaw node, updating notifications based on runtime status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notification channel, and launches coroutine to observe runtime status.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles service start commands, including stop actions.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutines and cancels ongoing jobs.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not supported.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel if not already existing.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Notification object with the current connection status.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Updates existing notification with new content.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts the foreground service with notification, or updates if already started.
